title: Lexeme
description: A dictionary/lemma-level source-language unit (Hebrew/Aramaic/Greek). Today's data has Strong's numbers only (no morphology/lemma) — this schema is the bridge from that v0 to real lexical data (lemma, gloss, semantic domain). Strong's is explicitly a bridge, NOT scholarly morphology (taxonomy-scaffold v0.2 Patch 5; ADR-0006).

strong.description: Strong's number (v0 bridge), e.g. H2617, G26.

lemma.description: Dictionary form in source script (populated when real lexical data lands).

glosses.description: Short English glosses; NOT a definition.

lexical_source.description: BDB, HALOT, BDAG, LSJ, Louw-Nida, SDBH, Strong's, ...
